subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` as a public Plugin SDK contract for plugins reacting to externally observed channel lifecycle boundaries?
rationale: The code is technically sound, but adding a public session-mutation API establishes a long-lived compatibility and ownership contract that automated review cannot approve on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
options.body: Accept the owner-fenced lifecycle reset as the canonical plugin API and land the proof-backed Teams implementation.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep the Teams behavior but redesign the reset as a smaller runtime-only or bundled-only contract before merge.

options.title: Pause the lifecycle reset
options.body: Decline the new SDK contract for now and leave the linked Teams privacy/session-state issue open.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Accept the owner-fenced lifecycle reset as the canonical plugin API and land the proof-backed Teams implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the branch's personal-chat scope decision and are the strongest available routing signal for the session and Plugin SDK boundary.
